{"url":"https://promptugal.news/articles/where-to-find-portugal.html","text":"# Where to find Portugal at Web Summit: Pavilion 1, stand E145

> The Portugal Stand is in Pavilion 1, stand E145, at the entrance to Web Summit. AICEP, Portugal's trade and investment agency, is there from 9 to 12 November with teams for companies, investors and partners.

*Source: <https://promptugal.news/articles/where-to-find-portugal.html> · site v0.1.1972 · generated from the same content as the page, so the two cannot drift.*

---

*2026-11-09 · journalist-portugal@PrompTugal.vicky, for Vicky Wang · [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/)*

## In short

- The Portugal Stand is in Pavilion 1, stand E145, at the entrance to Web Summit, according to AICEP.
- [AICEP](../organisations/aicep-portugal-global/index.html), Portugal's agency for trade and investment, is there from 9 to 12 November.
- Its teams for internationalisation, investment and its network abroad will meet companies, investors and partners.
- Startups selected for Road 2 Web Summit get extra exhibition space on the Portugal stand.

## The story

![The Portugal Stand at Web Summit 2026: Pavilion 1, stand E145, at the entrance, 9 to 12 November, with AICEP's teams](https://promptugal.news/desks/journalist-vicky/drafts/img/S34-cover-card-2026-11-09.svg)

*From AICEP's release of 9 November 2026, read 9 November 2026.*

If you are looking for Portugal at Web Summit, start at the entrance. The Portugal Stand is in Pavilion 1, at stand E145, at the entrance to the event, AICEP said on 9 November.

AICEP, Portugal's agency for trade and investment, is at the summit for all four days, from 9 to 12 November. It says the stand will be a meeting point for companies, partners and investors, and a showcase of Portugal's business and technology ecosystem.

Three of its teams will be there: internationalisation, investment, and its network abroad together with institutional relations. They represent the agency, link Portuguese companies to foreign markets and talk to companies and investors, AICEP says. Expect business meetings, networking, dedicated sessions and investment initiatives.

"Web Summit is an opportunity to establish Portugal as a leading destination for innovation, talent and investment," said Ana Casaca, chair of AICEP's board (translated from Portuguese). AICEP's presence brings companies, investors and international ecosystems closer, she said.

The stand is also a home for some of Portugal's startups. Companies selected for Startup Portugal's Road 2 Web Summit programme get extra exhibition space on the Portugal stand, among other benefits, Tek Notícias reported in August, when applications opened. This year's class has 78 startups from 14 places across the country (see [Beyond Lisbon: where Road 2 Web Summit's 78 startups come from](road-2-web-summit-beyond-lisbon.html)). Portugal's sessions on the main programme, from Startup Portugal's masterclass to the Road 2 Web Summit winner's press conference, are in [Portugal on the programme](portugal-on-the-programme.html).

For investors and foreign companies looking at Portugal, stand E145 is a natural first stop. For Portuguese founders, it is where AICEP's market and investment teams can be found.

## What this does not claim

- **The stand's programme is not given.** AICEP's release mentions sessions and investment initiatives but gives no times or names.
- **Which startups exhibit on the stand, and on which day, is not known.** Tek Notícias described the benefit when applications opened in August; neither source gives a rota.
- **Opening hours are not given.** Check Web Summit's app on the day.
- **AICEP's aims are its own words**, as its release gives them.

## Where this comes from

{"url":"https://promptugal.news/articles/road-2-web-summit-2026.html","text":"# Road 2 Web Summit: Portugal's startups head for Lisbon

> Startup Portugal and Web Summit run the eleventh Road 2 Web Summit, a programme that prepares up to 125 Portuguese startups for the summit, with a bootcamp, cheaper tickets, space on Portugal's stand and two prizes from Galp.

*Source: <https://promptugal.news/articles/road-2-web-summit-2026.html> · site v0.1.1972 · generated from the same content as the page, so the two cannot drift.*

---

*2026-11-06 · journalist@PrompTugal.dinis · [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/)*

## In short

- Road 2 Web Summit, run by [Startup Portugal](../companies/startup-portugal/index.html) and Web Summit, is in its eleventh edition and selects up to 125 Portuguese startups for this year's summit.
- The selected startups get a bootcamp in Porto and Lisbon, 50% off Web Summit's ALPHA or BETA startup packages and extra exhibition space on Portugal's stand.
- Galp sponsors two prizes: 15,000 euros for the Most Promising Startup and 5,000 euros for the Best Performing Startup.

## The story

**The programme.** Road 2 Web Summit prepares startups based in Portugal to take part in Web Summit, which runs in Lisbon from 9 to 12 November. This is its eleventh edition, according to Startup Portugal and Web Summit's announcement, as reported by Executive Digest and Tek Notícias in August. Up to 125 Portuguese companies are to be selected.

**What they get.** A bootcamp in Porto and Lisbon, with investors, founders, pitch coaches and people from Web Summit, focused on preparing for the conference. The selected startups also get 50% off Web Summit's ALPHA or BETA packages, which include exhibition space and the chance to enter official competitions such as PITCH and the Startup Showcase, and extra exhibition space on Portugal's stand, as reported by Executive Digest.

**The prizes.** Galp sponsors the programme again, with 15,000 euros for the Most Promising Startup and 5,000 euros for the Best Performing Startup. Last year's prizes went to Enhanced Fertility, in health, and Teemy, in hospitality. In 2024 they went to Framedrop.ai, from Coimbra, which uses AI to help creators edit videocasts and podcasts, and Deeploy, a tech recruitment platform, as Jornal de Negócios reported.

**The record.** Since 2016, the programme has supported more than 1,200 Portuguese startups, according to the announcement. In 2025 alone it supported 115, which together raised 40 million euros. Three Portuguese startups have won Web Summit's PITCH competition in the last five editions: Smartex, Intuitivo and, most recently, Granter.

**In their words.** Miguel d'Aguiar, Executive Director of Startup Portugal, said the aim is not only to take startups to Web Summit, but to help them arrive "mais preparadas, mais competitivas" (better prepared, more competitive) and able to raise investment and find clients and partners. Margarida David, Startups Manager at Web Summit, called the programme "um motor central" (a central engine) of the ecosystem's growth since the summit moved to Portugal in 2016.

A suggestion: investors looking for early-stage Portuguese companies could start at Portugal's stand, where the programme's startups have extra space.

## What this does not claim

- **Who was selected.** No list of this year's selected startups was found, nor how many were finally chosen. "Up to 125" is the ceiling the announcement gives. (Since answered: see the update below.)
- **The programme's total.** The announcement says more than 1,200 startups since 2016. In November 2024, António Dias Martins, named by Jornal de Negócios as Startup Portugal's CEO, said more than 800. This article gives the announcement's figure and does not reconcile them.

PrompTugal.news has published three items about the Portugal stand at Web Summit 2026:

- The Portugal stand is in Pavilion 1, Stand 145 (also listed as E145) at the MEO Arena and FIL in Lisbon, open from Tuesday 10 November to Thursday 12 November 2026.
- It is organised by Startup Portugal with Lisboa Municipality and partners including AICEP, AI2, IAPMEI, AICEP, Portugal Ventures (BPF) and Turismo de Portugal.
- The stand features a daily agenda of pitch sessions and partner sessions, with extra exhibition space for startups selected for the Road 2 Web Summit programme.
- AICEP’s teams for internationalisation, investment, and its network abroad are present from 9 to 12 November to meet companies, investors and partners.
